headlines.title_en: Reuters poll: Analysts cut gold price forecasts for first time since late 2023, but say central bank buying will cushion declines
headlines.summary_en: A Reuters survey showed that after gold prices fell sharply from record highs in January, analysts have cut their gold price forecasts for the first time since late 2023, although most still expect central bank buying and concerns over fiscal sustainability to provide support. In a survey of 29 analysts and traders over the past three weeks, the median gold price forecast for 2026 was $4,509 per ounce, down from $4,916 three months earlier, marking the first downgrade in 11 quarters. The average forecast for 2027 was $4,610, versus $5,100 in the previous survey. Gold hit an all-time high of $5,595 per ounce in January, but plunged sharply in Q2 as the Iran war exacerbated energy inflation and raised rate hike expectations, posting its worst quarter since 2013.

headlines.summary_en: On July 27, Changxin Technology, a leading domestic memory maker in the park, debuted on the STAR Market. It surged 465.82% on the first day to close at 49 yuan per share, with a market cap of 3.28 trillion yuan, topping A-share market value rankings. The wealth effect from capital gains prompted local property developers to seize the initiative early. As early as June this year, a real estate project launched 'targeted group buying' for Changxin Technology employees, and nearby property agents also ramped up promotions.

headlines.title_en: China's robotics supply chain sees order surge; one firm receives over 10,000 orders in a month
headlines.summary_en: As listed companies gradually release their semi-annual reports and performance forecasts, the robotics sector has seen a batch of positive earnings results in the first half of this year. From core components to system integration, and from motion control to AI computing hardware, the robotics supply chain is shifting from 'concept catalysts' to a new phase of 'order fulfillment and profit realization.' Data from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shows that from January to May, revenue of China's robotics industry enterprises above designated size exceeded 90 billion yuan, up 26.9% year-on-year, with average annual growth exceeding 20% over the past five years.

headlines.title: 中际旭创：拟以40亿元-80亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 中际旭创公告，公司于2026年7月28日收到董事长兼总裁刘圣先生出具的函件，提议公司使用自有或自筹资金以集中竞价交易方式回购部分A股股票。回购资金总额不低于40亿元（含）且不超过80亿元（含），回购价格不高于董事会审议通过回购方案前30个交易日股票交易均价的150%，回购股份将用于股权激励或员工持股计划，若未能在三年内使用完毕则予以注销。

headlines.title_en: Zhongji Innolight: Plans to repurchase 4 billion-8 billion yuan of company shares
headlines.summary_en: Zhongji Innolight announced that on July 28, 2026, it received a letter from Chairman and President Liu Sheng proposing to repurchase part of its A-shares using own or self-raised funds via centralized bidding. The total repurchase amount is no less than 4 billion yuan (inclusive) and no more than 8 billion yuan (inclusive), with a repurchase price not exceeding 150% of the average trading price in the 30 trading days before the board approves the plan. The repurchased shares will be used for equity incentives or employee stock ownership plans; if unused within three years, they will be cancelled.

headlines.title_en: UK 2/10-year gilt yields fall ~5 basis points
headlines.summary_en: In late European trading on Tuesday (July 28), the UK 10-year gilt yield fell 4.8 basis points to 4.949%, staying in negative territory throughout the session, with a trading range of 4.976%-4.945%, before a brief dip after 23:00 Beijing time near the day's low at 16:48. The 2-year gilt yield fell 5.3 bps to 4.328%, the 30-year gilt yield dropped 3.2 bps, and the 50-year gilt yield fell 3.1 bps. The 2/10-year yield spread rose 0.384 bps to +61.725 bps.

headlines.summary: 近日，三家银行在海南落地了全国首单三笔DR（存款类金融机构间债券回购利率）定价贷款。 具体来看，工商银行海南省分行、招商银行海口分行、浦发银行海口分行三家银行立足海南自贸港跨境经营主体集聚、EF账户体系较为成熟、金融开放场景丰富等优势，主动探索DR基准利率贷款创新应用，在海南自贸港落地全国首单三笔DR基准利率贷款。

headlines.title: 国家电投集团完成全球最大单批次绿氨出口
headlines.summary: 从国家电投集团获悉，电投绿能3750吨“氢洲·绿氨”当天从连云港离岸起航发往韩国，创下全球最大单批次绿氨出口纪录，这也是中国绿色燃料首次凭借全生命周期碳减排贡献，获得国际市场绿色价值认可。本次出口的绿氨产品全部产自国家电投“氢洲·大安绿氨”示范项目。作为国家清洁低碳氢能示范工程、战略性新兴产业“百大工程”，该项目2025年7月建成投产，配套新能源装机80万千瓦，可年产绿氢3.2万吨、绿氨18万吨。

headlines.title_en: State Power Investment Corp completes world's largest single batch of green ammonia export
headlines.summary_en: According to the State Power Investment Corp (SPIC), 3,750 tonnes of 'Hydrogen Oasis Green Ammonia' from SPIC's subsidiary departed from Lianyungang for South Korea, setting a global record for the largest single batch of green ammonia exports. This marks the first time Chinese green fuel has gained international market recognition for its full-lifecycle carbon reduction contribution. The exported green ammonia is entirely from SPIC's 'Hydrogen Oasis Da'an Green Ammonia' demonstration project, a national clean and low-carbon hydrogen energy demonstration and a strategic emerging industry 'top 100 project.' Commissioned in July 2025, the project is equipped with 800 MW of new energy capacity, capable of producing 32,000 tonnes of green hydrogen and 180,000 tonnes of green ammonia annually.
